App Pro Help

Block for creators

Use Pro with your own training. Share a code with your audience.

The offer

We give you Block Pro at no cost and a code for your audience. Your code gives new subscribers one month free on Pro Yearly, then $39.99 a year until they cancel.

We pay you $10 for each paid year that comes from your code. A free month, cancellation before payment, or refunded purchase does not count.

Get a code

Email support@lnkd.world with a link to where you post and the email of your Block account. We add Pro and send your code and link. Codes open when Block launches on the App Store.

When you share Block

  • Show the app with your own training.
  • Say that Block gives you Pro and pays you for paid years from your code.
  • Label Pro features. The AI trainer needs Pro and iOS 27.
  • Make no health, weight-loss, or guaranteed strength claims.

Questions about the offer or a payment? Use the same support address.
